summary.zh: 在长度接近的短文本之间进行平滑替换，保留阅读位置。
summary.en: Transition between similarly sized short labels while preserving reading position.

definition.zh: 文字变化时逐字符播放动画，把注意力引向新值。
definition.en: Characters or glyph shapes transition between text states to focus attention on updated content.

description.zh: 控制一次动效完成所需的时间。
description.en: Controls the time required for one motion cycle.

description.zh: 控制动效开始前的等待时间。
description.en: Controls the wait before motion begins.

description.zh: 控制速度随时间变化的方式。
description.en: Controls how velocity changes over time.

purpose.zh: 在长度接近的短文本值之间平滑替换，并把注意力引向变化内容。
purpose.en: Transition smoothly between similarly sized short text values and direct attention to the change.

frequency.zh: 适合低到中频指标、状态词和短标签；正文段落直接替换。
frequency.en: Use for low- to medium-frequency metrics, status words, and short labels, replacing body paragraphs directly.

trigger.zh: 由值变化触发，只动画发生变化的字符或词组。
trigger.en: Trigger on value change and animate only the characters or phrase that changed.

enterExit.zh: 旧字形弱化并让位，新字形在同一基线出现；容器宽度保持可预测。
enterExit.en: Soften and replace old glyphs as new glyphs appear on the same baseline, keeping container width predictable.

interruptibility.zh: 快速更新时合并中间值，只向最新文本收敛。
interruptibility.en: Coalesce rapid updates and settle only on the latest text.

gestureRules.zh: 无需手势；实时值提供 aria-live 策略，避免逐字符播报。
gestureRules.en: No gesture is required; use an aria-live strategy that avoids character-by-character announcements.

reducedMotion.zh: 立即替换完整文本，使用静态高亮或一次短淡入提示变化。
reducedMotion.en: Replace the full text immediately and use static highlighting or one short fade to signal change.

reviewNotes.zh: 测试不同字数、CJK 字符和换行边界。
reviewNotes.en: Test varying lengths, CJK characters, and wrapping boundaries.

reviewNotes.zh: 确保屏幕阅读器只接收最终值。
reviewNotes.en: Ensure screen readers receive only the final value.

summary.zh: 一次提交后，按钮、状态标记和文档状态一起抵达结果。
summary.en: A submission lands across the action, status marker, and document state together.

scene.zh: 产品更新编辑器中的一条已保存状态。
scene.en: A saved state inside a product-update editor.

note.zh: 保存中与已保存的文案在原位置更新。
note.en: Saving and Saved update in the same label position.

summary.zh: 把一项准备完成的更新，收束成一次有明确落点的发布。
summary.en: Resolve a ready update into a release with a clear landing point.

scene.zh: 发布产品更新时的版本面板。
scene.en: A version panel while publishing a product update.

note.zh: 版本标签与按钮文案同步切到已上线。
note.en: The version label and action copy switch to Live together.

summary.zh: 复制成功通过按钮与短提示共同确认，提示轻量离开。
summary.en: Copy success is confirmed through the action and a light, temporary cue.

scene.zh: 项目设置中的公开预览链接。
scene.en: A public preview link in project settings.

note.zh: 链接图标和按钮文案切换为已复制。
note.en: The link icon and button copy switch to Copied.

summary.zh: 在一组可视模板中确定方向，并把下一步操作稳定地接在选择之后。
summary.en: Choose direction from visual templates, then attach the next action steadily to that choice.

scene.zh: 创建新页面时选择一个起始模板。
scene.en: Choosing a starting template when creating a new page.

note.zh: 主按钮在原位置带出当前模板名称。
note.en: The primary action adopts the active template name in place.

summary.zh: 筛选条件变化时，让结果数量和可见项目一起更新。
summary.en: When a filter changes, update the result count and visible items together.

scene.zh: 资源库中按状态过滤设计文件。
scene.en: Filtering design files by status in a resource library.

note.zh: 结果数量在原位置随筛选范围更新。
note.en: The result count updates in place with the active filter scope.

summary.zh: 输入时提供贴近字段的方向，让用户持续停留在当前任务上。
summary.en: Offer direction close to the field while people stay in the current task.

scene.zh: 邀请协作者时填写电子邮箱。
scene.en: Entering an email address while inviting a collaborator.

note.zh: 字段旁的辅助文字随输入结果直接更新。
note.en: The nearby helper copy updates directly with the input result.

summary.zh: 在一个紧凑表面里筛选动作，并为键盘和指针提供相同的焦点反馈。
summary.en: Filter actions inside a compact surface with equal focus feedback for keyboard and pointer.

scene.zh: 文档工作区中快速跳转到一个常用动作。
scene.en: Jumping quickly to a common action from a document workspace.

note.zh: 键盘筛选后，当前高亮项持续表达下一次执行结果。
note.en: After keyboard filtering, the active row keeps the next execution clear.

summary.zh: 处理一条提醒后，让已完成感和下一条待处理内容自然接续。
summary.en: After handling a notification, let completion and the next pending item follow naturally.

scene.zh: 项目收件箱里清理两条待处理的更新。
scene.en: Clearing two pending updates from a project inbox.

note.zh: 剩余待处理数量与队列在原位置同步更新。
note.en: The remaining count updates in place with the queue.

summary.zh: 在连续任务中，让已完成、当前步骤和下一步形成清晰节奏。
summary.en: Across a multi-step task, make completed, current, and next steps form a clear cadence.

scene.zh: 设置公开页面时依次完成内容、分享和发布。
scene.en: Completing content, sharing, and publishing while setting up a public page.

note.zh: 右侧任务说明随当前步骤在原位置更新。
note.en: The task copy updates in place with the current step.

summary.zh: 发送邀请后，让输入表单自然转化为一个可追踪的待加入成员。
summary.en: After an invite is sent, turn the form naturally into a trackable pending member.

scene.zh: 在项目设置中邀请新的设计协作者。
scene.en: Inviting a new design collaborator from project settings.

note.zh: 按钮文案和成员状态共同表达待接受结果。
note.en: Action copy and member status jointly express the pending result.
